LESSON: IDDAH

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.2: Iddah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Iddah
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is the wisdom behind Iddah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the iddah for a divorcee and a widow in Islam to foster obedience to divine guidance
2. explain the rationale for observing iddah as an act of ibadah
3. state the rules of iddah as a means of safeguarding its validity
4. appreciate iddah as an act of ibadah
